a method for the simultaneous analysis of cytochrome p450 metabolites of linoleic and/or arachidonic acids in urine has been developed and validated.
a method for the simultaneous quantitative determination of linoleate and omega 6 arachidonate epoxides and omega hydroxy fatty acids in urine has been developed.

we have developed a method to simultaneously measure the urinary excretion of linoleic acid derived epoxy and dihydroxylated fatty acids, as well as arachidonic and linoleic acid-derived hydroxy fatty acids.

the development of a sensitive method for quantification of urinary epoxides and hydroxy fatty acids.
the identification and characterization of the enzymatic products of linoleate and its major metabolite arachidonate in urine.
the development and application of a sensitive and specific method for the simultaneous analysis of urinary linoleate and omega-3 fatty acid epoxides, diols, and omega hydroxylates.
